home.appText:
Invest in real assets in a simple, safe and regulated way by the CVM.
 
 With the Tokeniza app, you can access exclusive opportunities and 
 track your income in real time.
home.cvmSecurity: This platform is secured by CVM
home.investText1: Tokeniza, authorized by CVM, facilitates investments in real assets through tokenization. We turn assets like real estate and plantations into digital 'tokens' that you can easily buy and sell, accessing previously complex markets. Ideal for those seeking innovation and wanting to stay ahead of financial trends.
home.descoveryAssets:
Discover the most
 desired assets and join
 rising investors.
home.agroText: Agro brings tokenization innovation to the agricultural sector. Invest in farms, crops, horses, cattle, and other assets by acquiring tokens representing fractions of these goods. It's a simple and accessible way to invest in a vital sector, contributing to sustainable development and food security.
home.autoText: Auto turns the dream of owning luxury or classic cars into reality. Through tokenization, vehicles become tradable assets accessible to everyone. Invest in fractions of rare, luxury cars or even yachts, and gain usage rights or profit shares when the asset is sold.
home.athleteText: Athlete allows you to invest in the future of promising athletes. With the tokenization of sports careers, you share in the risks and rewards, profiting from the success of emerging talents. It's an innovative way to support and invest in sports talent.
home.financeText: Finance democratizes access to financial assets once exclusive to major banks. Now, any investor can buy tokens representing fractions of precatórios, receivables, credit securities, and other financial products, easily diversifying their portfolios.
home.propertyText: Property is revolutionizing the real estate market. Buy tokens that represent fractions of real estate, allowing anyone, regardless of budget, to invest in the sector. Additionally, tokenization offers liquidity, enabling you to sell your share at any time.
home.startupText: Startup opens the door to investing in emerging companies. By acquiring tokens representing equity fractions in promising startups, you become a co-owner of these businesses. Invest in innovation and have the chance to profit from the next big market success.
home.investTipsText1: Starting your investment journey with Tokeniza is easy. Upon registration, we will review your documents to make you eligible to invest and allow you to participate in the first fundraisings.
home.investTipsText2: After the review, you will receive confirmation and access by email. At this point, just look for the fundraising that best fits your profile, whether real estate, agro, or any other category.
home.investTipsText3: We move forward together. After your first investment, simply follow the periodic reports on the fundraising and get ready for your next investments.
home.completedOperations:
Completed operations yielded from 14%
 to 40% per year for our more than 72 thousand
 investors.

crowdfunding.faq.title: FAQ
crowdfunding.faq.guarantee.title: What is Tokeniza?
crowdfunding.faq.guarantee.description: Tokeniza is a digital platform for asset tokenization via crowdfunding. It allows both investors and issuers to access opportunities in the financial market securely and efficiently through the use of blockchain technology.
crowdfunding.faq.fgc.title: How does asset tokenization work?
crowdfunding.faq.fgc.description: Tokenization is the process of converting rights to an asset into digital tokens. These tokens represent a fraction of the underlying asset and can be traded on secondary platforms or used in various financial applications.
crowdfunding.faq.investmentsContract.tit: What are the benefits for investors?
crowdfunding.faq.investmentsContract.des: Liquidity: Tokenization can turn traditionally illiquid assets into liquid ones, enabling trading in a secondary market. Diversification: Investors can acquire fractions of assets, allowing for portfolio diversification with lower capital. Transparency: The crowdfunding platform, combined with blockchain technology, provides an immutable and transparent transaction record. Access: Tokeniza provides access to assets that are otherwise difficult or expensive to acquire through traditional means.
crowdfunding.faq.tributation.title: What are the benefits for issuers?
crowdfunding.faq.tributation.description: Access to capital: Tokenization facilitates fundraising by offering assets to a broader audience. Asset liquidity: Converts illiquid assets into tradable fractions, generating liquidity. Lower cost: Potential reduction in costs associated with traditional fundraising processes.
crowdfunding.faq.deadline.title: Is it safe to invest through Tokeniza?
crowdfunding.faq.deadline.description: Tokeniza is a platform approved by the CVM and recognized for its security and transparency. Although all investments carry risks, we take every possible measure to ensure the safety of transactions and the integrity of tokenized assets.
How do I start investing with Tokeniza?

To start investing: Sign up on our platform, complete the identity verification process, browse the available opportunities, choose where you want to invest, and follow the instructions to complete your token purchase.
crowdfunding.faq.investmentGuarantee.tit: How can I tokenize my asset?
crowdfunding.faq.investmentGuarantee.des: If you are an issuer and want to tokenize an asset: Contact our team through the 'Contact Us' section, provide details about the asset you wish to tokenize, and our team will evaluate its feasibility and guide you through the next steps.
crowdfunding.faq.investmentFollow.title: Can the tokens be traded on other platforms?
crowdfunding.faq.investmentFollow.descri: No. Once acquired, tokens can be traded on a secondary market within Tokeniza if the issuer provides this option. Each offering includes information about its tradability.
crowdfunding.faq.annualReport.title: What is Tokeniza's fee structure?
crowdfunding.faq.annualReport.descriptio: Tokeniza has a transparent and straightforward fee structure: We charge 5% of the total raised at the time of asset tokenization, which can be paid by the issuer or the investor, at the issuer's discretion. When the investor sells their token, we apply a 10% fee on the profit earned.
crowdfunding.faq.incomeTax.title: How does Tokeniza ensure regulatory compliance?
crowdfunding.faq.incomeTax.description: We have a dedicated team that constantly monitors changes in regulations and ensures that our platform is always compliant with current laws and regulations.
crowdfunding.faq.newsProjects.title: What types of assets can be tokenized?
crowdfunding.faq.newsProjects.descriptio: Tokeniza is capable of tokenizing a variety of assets, including real estate, vehicles, receivables, agricultural assets, company shares, and more. Check our platform for a complete list of available assets.
crowdfunding.faq.reserveInvestment.title: Is there a minimum investment amount?
crowdfunding.faq.reserveInvestment.descr: Yes, each investment opportunity may have a minimum entry amount. Specific details can be found in the asset information on our platform.
crowdfunding.faq.risk.title: Do I risk losing my principal?
crowdfunding.faq.risk.description: Since the acquired credit rights are part of the undisputed value, the loss of the principal would be highly exceptional and remote, but all investments carry risks.
crowdfunding.faq.returnInvestment.title: How will I receive my investment back?
crowdfunding.faq.returnInvestment.descri: To the bank account that matches the account holder in the platform registration and contract.
crowdfunding.faq.payments.title: What are the payment methods for credit rights?
crowdfunding.faq.payments.description: Only via bank transfer (TED) from an account that matches the platform registration and contract holder. Our compliance policies and anti-money laundering rules do not allow transfers from third-party accounts or legal entities.
crowdfunding.faq.qualify.title: Do I need to be a qualified investor to invest?
crowdfunding.faq.qualify.description: No. Anyone can invest in credit rights. Currently, the minimum amount per operation is R$10,000.00, and the maximum is 20% of the investor's net worth.
crowdfunding.faq.howWorksContractInvestm: How does the investment contract work?

The contract is a transfer of credit rights, meaning a buy and sell transaction. PRECATÓRIOS DO BRASIL acts as a custodian only for the purpose of requesting an agreement and withdrawal. At any time, the investor can take the private transfer contract for registration and present it in the process, becoming, for all purposes, the owner of part of the credit right. The deposit business presumes accounting and payment delivery to the rightful party.
crowdfunding.faq.assetJudicial.title: Why private judicial asset?
crowdfunding.faq.assetJudicial.descripti: A judicial asset is private when both parties of the process are private entities (anything except the government).
crowdfunding.faq.differencePrecatory.tit: What is the difference from a precatório?
crowdfunding.faq.differencePrecatory.des: When a process against a governmental entity concludes, payment is made through a credit instrument called a precatório. In Private Credit Rights, when the process is completed, the payment is made directly from one party to another.
crowdfunding.faq.depositJudiciary.title: What is a judicial deposit?
crowdfunding.faq.depositJudiciary.descri: Judges often require the debtor to deposit an amount of money to discuss the debt in the process. This money is deposited in a bank account linked to the process and is only released with the judge's authorization.

crowdfunding.disclaimer.one: The offering on this platform is exempt from registration by the Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM) under CVM Resolution No. 88, and therefore, there has been no prior evaluation by the CVM. Before participating in any offering, it is essential that investors carefully read the key information, especially the section on risk warnings.
crowdfunding.disclaimer.two: This document is for informational purposes only and does not represent an offer for sale or a request to buy. The complete details and conditions of the operation are specified in the 'Terms of the Offering and Offering Educational Material', in addition to the 'Term of Adhesion and Risk Acknowledgment', which investors must sign to participate.
crowdfunding.disclaimer.three: It is important to emphasize that this content does not constitute a recommendation or investment advice. The decision to invest should be based on the investor's individual analysis, considering their objectives and risk tolerance. All investments involve risks, including the possibility of loss of the invested capital. Investment decisions should consider the investor's objectives, timeline, and risk tolerance.
crowdfunding.section6Text1: There is a possibility of losing the entire investment due to the failure of the Issuer.
crowdfunding.section6Text2: The Investor has the right to withdraw from the investment, without incurring any fines or penalties, until the 7th (seventh) day after signing the Term of Adhesion or making the investment deposit, whichever comes first.
crowdfunding.section6Text3: If the Issuer is not incorporated as a corporation, there is no obligation to convert into this type of entity, which would prevent the conversion of debt securities into shares.
crowdfunding.section6Text4: The securities are issued digitally, in a non-book-entry form, and their custody is the responsibility of the Investor.
crowdfunding.section6Text5: There is no regulated secondary market for trading securities acquired in an offering exempt from registration under CVM Instruction No. 588.
crowdfunding.section6Text6: The Issuer is not registered with the CVM, so there may not be continuous information provision after the offering.
crowdfunding.section6Text7: There is a risk of the Platform's operations being discontinued
crowdfunding.section6Text8: which may affect the availability of information about the Issuer after the offering.
crowdfunding.section9Text1: Investors will need to pay a Performance Fee to the Platform
crowdfunding.section9Text2: of 10% on any gains they make from the sale of their assets.
crowdfunding.section9Text3: In the case of successful fundraising, the company will bear 5% of the raised amount, paid to the
crowdfunding.section10Text5: through the acquisition of [NUMBER OF HELD TITLES] investment contracts in shares issued by the company, with a unit nominal value of R$ 100.00 each, totaling R$ [TOTAL INVESTMENT AMOUNT].
crowdfunding.section10Text6: Applicable taxation in case of capital return: LAW No. 13,259, MARCH 16, 2016.
crowdfunding.section10Text7: The capital gain realized by an individual from the sale of assets and rights of any nature is subject to income tax at the following rates:
crowdfunding.section10Text8: I - 15% (fifteen percent) on the portion of the gains that does not exceed R$ 5,000,000.00 (five million reais);
crowdfunding.section10Text9: II - 17.5% (seventeen and five-tenths percent) on the portion of the gains exceeding R$ 5,000,000.00 (five million reais) but not exceeding R$ 10,000,000.00 (ten million reais);
crowdfunding.section10Text10: III - 20% (twenty percent) on the portion of the gains exceeding R$ 10,000,000.00 (ten million reais) but not exceeding R$ 30,000,000.00 (thirty million reais);
crowdfunding.section10Text11: IV - 22.5% (twenty-two and five-tenths percent) on the portion of the gains exceeding R$ 30,000,000.00 (thirty million reais).
crowdfunding.section10Text12: Warning: The Federal Revenue Service may, at any time and without prior notice, change the tax regulations applicable to the investment. Our recommendation is that you consult a qualified professional for further information on the tax applicable to your investments.
crowdfunding.section10Text13: * Applicable taxation may be changed by the Federal Revenue Service without prior notice. We recommend that you consult professionals for further information on the applicable taxation.
crowdfunding.section11Text1: The small business company and the offering presented on this platform are automatically exempt from registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission - CVM.
crowdfunding.section11Text2: CVM does not review offers beforehand.
crowdfunding.section11Text3: Offers made do not imply a guarantee by CVM regarding the truthfulness of the provided information, compliance with current legislation, or judgment on the quality of the small business company.
crowdfunding.section11Text4: Before accepting an offer, carefully read the essential information about the offer, especially the section on risk warnings.
